vocabulary_concerns: ‘Income beyond reimbursement’ must retain the full exception: reimbursement of operating expenses from the family. It does not mean merely net profit, positive cash flow, or any payment labelled reimbursement.

‘Profit objective’ concerns the office arrangement's business objective. It must not automatically include investment returns pursued for family members; the source expressly contemplates serving their investment needs.

‘Genuine single family arrangement’ remains a judgment, not a statutory definition. Q1 says the Ordinance defines neither ‘family’ nor ‘family office’; Q2 gives a typical arrangement rather than mandatory ownership or kinship criteria.

‘Should not in the ordinary course’ expresses qualified guidance. No candidate loses that modality if its Boolean remains limited to antecedent satisfaction; applying TRUE as an exemption, or FALSE as proof of business status, would lose it.
